adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is initialized as `eventType.destinationCalendar ? [..] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [..] : null` (so it can be `null`). Immediately after, for COLLECTIVE team events the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`, which becomes a silent no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`. This means the previously collected `teamDestinationCalendars` (gathered from `users.slice(1)` when `eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE"`) are dropped and never reach `EventManager.createAllCalendarEvents`, contradicting the intended multi-destination handling for collective events in that edge case.
